description: Game accuracy regressions from an independent audit (2026-11-22). Inputs are engine evals only (white-POV centipawns per position, mates as +-1000, the final position last); no PGN, players or game ids. `lila` is an independent re-implementation of lila AccuracyPercent.gameAccuracy; `before` is what the app computed before the A2/A4 fix.

cases.name: harmonic-floor
cases.note: 142 positions (window 8 either way); one black move has accuracy 0, which zeroed the harmonic mean before the fix

cases.name: window-from-moves
cases.note: 30 positions, 29 moves: the window is 29 / 10 = 2 (lila), not 30 / 10 = 3
